function.name: tool_getProducts
function.description: Search products by ID, reference, name, or price range. Use @ for wildcards. Returns ID, Reference, Name, Sale_Price. Counts object: 'total'=all in DB, 'totalFiltered'=matching criteria, 'totalSent'=returned (limited by 'top').

ID.description: Product ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search by other criteria.

Reference.description: Product reference. Supports @ wildcard. Example: 'PRD@' matches references starting with PRD. Defaults to '@'.

Name.description: Product name. Supports @ wildcard. Example: '@laptop@' matches names containing 'laptop'. Defaults to '@'.

field.description: Sort field: ID, Reference, Name, Sale_Price. Defaults to 'Name'.

top.description: Max results to return. Defaults to system limit.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only counts without entity data. Use to count matches without retrieving details.

function.name: tool_getClients
function.description: Search clients by ID, name, contact, or total sales range. Use @ for wildcards. Returns ID, Name, Contact, City, State, Country, Discount_Rate, Total_Sales, Comments. Counts object: 'total'=all in DB, 'totalFiltered'=matching criteria, 'totalSent'=returned (limited by 'top').

ID.description: Client ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search by other criteria.

Name.description: Client name. Supports @ wildcard. Example: '@Smith@' matches names containing 'Smith'. Defaults to '@'.

Contact.description: Contact person. Supports @ wildcard. Defaults to '@'.

field.description: Sort field: ID, Name, Contact, City, State, Country, Discount_Rate, Total_Sales, Comments. Defaults to 'Name'.

top.description: Max results to return. Defaults to system limit.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only counts without entity data. Use to count matches without retrieving details.

function.name: tool_getInvoices
function.description: Search invoices by number, client ID, date range, or total range. Use @ for wildcards. Returns ID, Invoice_Number, Client_ID, Creation_Date, Paid, Payment_Date, Total. Counts object: 'total'=all in DB, 'totalFiltered'=matching criteria, 'totalSent'=returned (limited by 'top').

Invoice_Number.description: Invoice number. Supports @ wildcard. Example: 'INV@' matches numbers starting with INV. Defaults to '@'.

Client_ID.description: Client ID filter. Use 'any' or omit to search all clients.

field.description: Sort field: ID, Invoice_Number, Client_ID, Creation_Date, Paid, Payment_Date, Total. Defaults to 'Total'.

top.description: Max results to return. Defaults to system limit.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only counts without entity data. Use to count matches without retrieving details.

function.name: tool_getInvoiceLines
function.description: Search invoice lines by invoice number/ID, client ID, product ID, quantity or total range. Use @ for wildcards. Returns ID, Line_Number, Invoice.Invoice_Number, Invoice.Client_ID, Total, Quantity, Product.Reference, Product.Name. Counts object: 'total'=all in DB, 'totalFiltered'=matching criteria, 'totalSent'=returned (limited by 'top').

Invoice_Number.description: Invoice number. Supports @ wildcard. Defaults to '@'.

Invoice_ID.description: Invoice ID for direct lookup. Use 'any' or omit to search all invoices.

Client_ID.description: Client ID filter. Use 'any' or omit to search all clients.

Product_ID.description: Product ID filter. Use 'any' or omit to search all products.

field.description: Sort field: ID, Line_Number, Total, Quantity. Defaults to 'Total'.

top.description: Max results to return. Defaults to system limit.

countOnly.description: When true, returns only counts without entity data. Use to count matches without retrieving details.

function.name: tool_createInvoice
function.description: Creates a new invoice with lines. Requires valid Client_ID and at least one line with existing Product_ID. Auto-calculates totals and taxes.

Client_ID.description: Client ID (required). Must exist in CLIENTS database.

Paid.description: If true, provide Payment_Date, Payment_Method, Payment_Reference.

Payment_Method.description: Payment method (Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Check, Cash). Only if Paid=true.

Payment_Reference.description: Payment reference/transaction ID. Only if Paid=true.

Product_ID.description: Product ID (required). Must exist in PRODUCTS database.
